title: Download a shared file as a public visitor
description: A public visitor can download a shared file from the shared link page.

steps.description: Navigate to a valid shared file link under /s/[token]
Click the download action for the shared file
Verify the file download action is available
Verify the shared file remains accessible after initiating download

title: Access the dashboard after signing in
description: A signed-in user can authenticate and reach the protected vault dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify the vault interface is available

title: Open a shared file as a public visitor
description: A public visitor can open a shared link and see the shared file page without signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to a valid shared file link under /s/[token]
Verify the shared file page is displayed
Verify the file is available for public access

title: Upload files into the vault
description: A signed-in user with connected storage can upload files and see them appear in the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Add one or more files to the upload area
Start the upload
Verify upload progress is displayed
Verify the newly uploaded files are displayed in the vault

title: Connect Supabase credentials from settings
description: An authenticated user can save valid Supabase credentials in settings and return to an active vault setup.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the settings section from the dashboard
Fill in the Supabase URL field with a valid Supabase project URL
Fill in the Supabase Anon Key field with a valid Supabase anon key
Save the Supabase credentials
Verify the Supabase connection is saved
Verify the vault is ready for file management

title: Open a shared file page from a valid token without signing in
description: A public visitor can open a valid shared token and see the shared content instead of a gated view.

steps.description: Navigate to a valid shared file link under /s/[token]
Verify the shared content is displayed
Verify a sign-in prompt is not required

title: Generate and open a public share link
description: A user can create a secure share link for a file, open it as a public visitor, and access the shared file page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Open the sharing options for an uploaded file
Generate a secure share link
Open the generated public share link as a visitor
Verify the shared file page is displayed
Verify the shared file can be downloaded

title: Delete a single vault file
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can delete one file from the vault and see it removed from the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open the delete action for a file
Confirm deletion
Verify the file is removed from the list

title: Upload files with progress and completion feedback
description: A user uploading multiple files sees progress feedback, completion feedback, and the vault updates after upload.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Add multiple files to the upload area
Start the upload
Verify upload progress is displayed
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the vault refreshes with the uploaded files

title: Rename a vault file
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can rename an existing file and see the updated filename in the vault list.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open the rename action for a file
Fill in a new filename in the rename dialog
Submit the rename
Verify the updated filename appears in the file list

title: Generate and copy a share link for a single file
description: A signed-in vault owner can generate a secure share link for one file and copy it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the sign-in credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the share action for a file in the vault
Copy the generated share link
Verify a share link is generated
Verify the link copy confirmation is visible

title: Generate and copy a batch share link for selected files
description: A signed-in vault owner can select multiple files, generate one secure share link for the batch, and copy it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the sign-in credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Select multiple files in the vault
Open the batch share action
Copy the generated share link
Verify a batch share link is generated
Verify the link copy confirmation is visible

title: Delete multiple selected vault files
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can batch delete selected files after entering the required confirmation phrase and see the selected items removed.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Select multiple files in the vault
Open the batch delete action
Type the required confirmation phrase
Submit the deletion
Verify the selected files are removed from the list
Verify the bulk selection state is cleared

title: Rename an uploaded file
description: A user can rename an existing file and see the updated name in the vault.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Open the file actions for an uploaded file
Choose to rename the file
Fill in the file name field with a new name
Save the file name change
Verify the file is displayed with the updated name

title: Select multiple files and batch delete them
description: A user can select multiple files, confirm the batch delete action, and see the vault update.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Select multiple files in the vault
Choose the batch delete action
Enter the confirmation phrase required for deletion
Confirm the batch delete
Verify the selected files are removed from the vault

title: Preview an uploaded file in the modal
description: A user can open a file preview from the vault and inspect its contents in a modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Open the preview for an uploaded file
Verify a file preview modal is displayed
Verify the file contents are visible in the preview

title: Preview a vault file in a modal
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can open a file preview from the vault and inspect it in a modal before closing it.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open a file preview from the vault
Verify the file content is displayed in a preview modal
Close the preview
Verify the preview modal is no longer visible

title: Open a file preview in fullscreen
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can expand a file preview into fullscreen mode from the vault preview modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open a file preview from the vault
Launch fullscreen preview
Verify the file is displayed in fullscreen preview
Close fullscreen preview

title: Use fullscreen preview and return to file management
description: A user can launch fullscreen preview from a file preview and continue managing files afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Open the preview for an uploaded file
Launch fullscreen preview
Close fullscreen preview
Verify the file management view remains available
Verify the preview can be reopened from the vault

title: Prevent renaming a file without a filename
description: This test verifies that the rename dialog rejects an empty filename and keeps the file unchanged.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Open the rename action for a file
Clear the filename field
Submit the rename
Verify a filename validation error is visible
Verify the file remains unchanged in the list

title: Handle an empty vault state
description: A signed-in user with no uploaded files sees an empty vault state instead of file rows.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify an empty vault state is displayed
Verify no files are listed

title: Cancel batch delete when the confirmation phrase is missing
description: This test verifies that batch delete is blocked until the required confirmation phrase is entered and no files are removed when it is omitted.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Select multiple files in the vault
Open the batch delete action
Leave the confirmation phrase empty
Submit the deletion
Verify a confirmation phrase validation error is visible
Verify the selected files remain in the list
